items.title: Exclude parked main-authority backlog from the hard Story completion check
items.context: B-4622, B-d7af, and B-da5b are INIT authority=main backlog with no worktree. They should not make convergence_check red when no one is actively executing them. Active worktree stories such as B-6974 must remain blocking.

items.title: Expose parked backlog as an advisory convergence check
items.context: convergence_check should still show parked backlog explicitly so users can decide whether to complete, discard, or schedule it later, but this advisory should not set converged=false.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for parked INIT, active worktree, DONE, DISCARDED, and META semantics
items.context: The smoke should prove parked INIT no longer blocks, active worktree remains blocking, META remains excluded from Story completion, and terminal stories remain ignored.
